title: Record a journal entry
summary: Post a manual entry straight into the ledger.

steps.text: Open {acct} from the sidebar to see every posted entry for the period.
Click {new} to post a manual entry: pick an account for each line, enter a debit or credit, and save.
You can also ask the assistant to find entries, record a manual journal entry or void one. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
